arxiv-2011-11247.title: Restricted Airspace Protection using Multi-UAV Spatio-Temporal Multi-Task Allocation
arxiv-2011-11247.creator: Shridhar Velhal, Suresh Sundaram
arxiv-2011-11247.description: Abstract This paper addresses the problem of restricted airspace protection from invaders using the cooperative multi-UAV system. The objective is to detect and capture the invaders cooperatively by a team of homogeneous UAVs (called evaders) before invaders enter the restricted airspace.

arxiv-2012-12340.title: NMR Investigation on Honeycomb Iridate Ag 3 LiIr 2 O 6
arxiv-2012-12340.creator: Jiaming Wang, Weishi Yuan, Takashi Imai, Philip M.Singer, Faranak Bahrami, Fazel Tafti
arxiv-2012-12340.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Jiaming Wang, Weishi Yuan, Takashi Imai, Philip M.Singer, Faranak Bahrami, Fazel Tafti. Ag 3 LiIr 2 O 6 is a Kitaev spin liquid candidate material synthesised from α \alpha -Li 2 IrO 3 through a topotactic reaction. We investigate the structural and magnetic properties of two samples of Ag 3 LiIr 2 O 6 based on 7 Li nuclear magnetic resonance line shape, Knight shift and spin-lattice relaxation rate 1 / T 1 1/T_{1} .

arxiv-2110-08753.title: Understanding Players’ Interaction Patterns with Mobile Game App UI via Visualizations Conference: The Ninth International Symposium of Chinese CHI; October 16–17, 2021; Online, Hong Kong The Ninth International Symposium of Chinese CHI (Chinese CHI 2021), October 16–17, 2021, Online, Hong Kong Pric
arxiv-2110-08753.creator: Quan Li, Haipeng Zeng, Zhenhui Peng, Xiaojuan Ma
arxiv-2110-08753.description: Abstract . Understanding how players interact with the mobile game app on smartphone devices is important for game experts to develop and refine their app products. Conventionally, the game experts achieve their purposes through intensive user studies with target players or iterative UI design processes, which can not capture interaction patterns of large-scale individual players.

arxiv-2206-10686.title: Remotely Controlled Entanglement Generation
arxiv-2206-10686.creator: Ferran Riera-Sàbat, Pavel Sekatski, Wolfgang Dür
arxiv-2206-10686.description: Abstract We consider a system of multiple qubits without any quantum control. We show that one can mediate entanglement between different subsystems in a controlled way by adding a (locally) controlled auxiliary system of the same size that couples via an always-on, distant-dependent interaction to the system qubits.

arxiv-2212-05171.title: ULIP: Learning a Unified Representation of Language, Images, and Point Clouds for 3D Understanding
arxiv-2212-05171.creator: Le Xue, Mingfei Gao, Chen Xing, Roberto Martín-Martín, Jiajun Wu, Caiming Xiong, Ran Xu, Juan Carlos Niebles, Silvio Savarese
arxiv-2212-05171.description: Abstract The recognition capabilities of current state-of-the-art 3D models are limited by datasets with a small number of annotated data and a pre-defined set of categories. In its 2D counterpart, recent advances have shown that similar problems can be significantly alleviated by employing knowledge from other modalities, such as language.

arxiv-2303-10170.title: Generic axion Maxwell equations: path integral approach
arxiv-2303-10170.creator: Andreas Ringwald
arxiv-2303-10170.description: Abstract Using the path integral approach, we derive the low energy interactions between axions and electromagnetic fields that arise in models with heavy dyons charged under a spontaneously broken global axial U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) symmetry. Hence, we obtain generic axion-Maxwell equations relevant for experimental searches.

arxiv-2411-19526.title: A Local Information Aggregation based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Robot Swarm Dynamic Task Allocation
arxiv-2411-19526.creator: Yang Lv, Jinlong Lei, Peng Yi
arxiv-2411-19526.description: Abstract In this paper, we explore how to optimize task allocation for robot swarms in dynamic environments, emphasizing the necessity of formulating robust, flexible, and scalable strategies for robot cooperation. We introduce a novel framework using a decentralized partially observable Markov decision process (Dec_POMDP), specifically designed for distributed robot swarm networks.

arxiv-2501-06780.title: COMPASS: A Compiler Framework for Resource-Constrained Crossbar-Array Based In-Memory Deep Learning Accelerators
arxiv-2501-06780.creator: Jihoon Park ∗ , Jeongin Choe ∗ , Dohyun Kim, Jae-Joon Kim
arxiv-2501-06780.description: Abstract Recently, crossbar array based in-memory accelerators have been gaining interest due to their high throughput and energy efficiency. While software and compiler support for the in-memory accelerators has also been introduced, they are currently limited to the case where all weights are assumed to be on-chip.

arxiv-2501-10541.title: REBELS-IFU: Dust attenuation curves of 12 massive galaxies at 𝐳 ≃ 𝟕 \mathbf{z\simeq 7}
arxiv-2501-10541.creator: R. Fisher, R. A. A. Bowler, M. Stefanon, L. E. Rowland, H. S. B. Algera, M. Aravena, R. Bouwens, P. Dayal, A. Ferrara, Y. Fudamoto, J. A. Hodge, H. Inami, K. Ormerod, A. Pallottini, S. G. Phillips, N. S. Sartorio, R. Smit, L. Sommovigo, D. P. Stark, P. P. van der Werf
arxiv-2501-10541.description: Abstract We present measurements of the dust attenuation curves of 12 massive ( 9 < log 9~<~\log ( M ⋆ M_{\star} / M ⊙ {\rm M}_{\odot} ) < 10 <~10 ) Lyman-break galaxies at z = 6.5 − 7.7 z=6.5-7.7 derived from James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) NIRSpec integral field unit (IFU) spectroscopy.

arxiv-2503-13898.title: A metropolitan-scale trapped-ion quantum network node with hybrid multiplexing enhancements
arxiv-2503-13898.creator: Z.-B. Cui, Z.-Q. Wang, P.-C. Lai, Y. Wang, J.-X. Shi, P.-Y. Liu, Y.-D. Sun, Z.-C. Tian, Y.-B. Liang, B.-X. Qi, Y.-Y. Huang, Z.-C. Zhou, Y.-K. Wu, Y. Xu, L.-M. Duan, Y.-F. Pu
arxiv-2503-13898.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Z.-B. Cui, Z.-Q. Wang, P.-C. Lai, Y. Wang, J.-X. Shi, P.-Y. Liu, Y.-D. Sun, Z.-C. Tian, Y.-B. Liang, B.-X. Qi, Y.-Y. Huang, Z.-C. Zhou, Y.-K. Wu, Y. Xu, L.-M. Duan, Y.-F. Pu. Quantum network and quantum repeater are promising ways to scale up a quantum information system to enable various applications with unprecedented performance.

arxiv-2505-13647.title: On z ∘ z^{\circ} -ideals and annihilator ideals
arxiv-2505-13647.creator: Ali Taherifar ∗ {}^{{}^{*}}
arxiv-2505-13647.description: Abstract . For a ∈ R a\in R , let P a P_{a} denote the intersection of all minimal prime ideals of R R containing a a . An ideal I I of a ring R R is called a z ∘ z^{\circ} -ideal if P a ⊆ I P_{a}\subseteq I for all a ∈ I a\in I .

arxiv-2507-08252.title: Witnessing nonlocality in quantum network of continuous-variable systems by generalized quasiprobability functions
arxiv-2507-08252.creator: Taotao Yan, Jinchuan Hou, Xiaofei Qi, Kan He
arxiv-2507-08252.description: Abstract Gaussian measurements can not be used to witness nonlocality in Gaussian states as well as the network nonlocality in networks of continuous-variable (CV) systems. Thus special non-Gaussian measurements have to be utilized. In the present paper, we first propose a kind of nonlinear Bell-type inequality that is applicable to quantum networks of both finite or infinite dimensional systems.

arxiv-2601-19826.title: Whether We Care, How We Reason: The Dual Role of Anthropomorphism and Moral Foundations in Robot Abuse CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in HCI CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in HCI
arxiv-2601-19826.creator: Fan Yang, Renkai Ma, Yaxin Hu, Lingyao Li
arxiv-2601-19826.description: Abstract . As robots become increasingly integrated into daily life, understanding responses to robot mistreatment carries important ethical and design implications. This mixed-methods study ( N = 201) examined how anthropomorphic levels and moral foundations shape reactions to robot abuse.

pmc-10737796.creator: Gabriela Ochiai, Caroline De Godoy, Erika Gouveia E Silva, Celso Ricardo Fernandes De Carvalho, Carolina Fu, Clarice Tanaka, Carlos Roberto Ribeiro De Carvalho, Jose Pompeu
pmc-10737796.description: Cross-sectional study of 159 individuals, one month after hospitalization at the Hospital das Clínicas of the University of São Paulo for Covid-19, divided into groups: 54.7% (n=87) were adults (< 60 years), and 45.3% (n=72) were older people (≥60 years), with 43.4% (n=69) being female.

pmc-11469629.title: Moderate IV Fluid Resuscitation Is Associated With Decreased Sepsis Mortality
pmc-11469629.creator: Keith A. Corl, Mitchell M. Levy, Andre L. Holder, Ivor S. Douglas, Walter T. Linde-Zwirble, Aftab Alam
pmc-11469629.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). OBJECTIVES:Significant practice variation exists in the amount of resuscitative IV fluid given to patients with sepsis. Current research suggests equipoise between a tightly restrictive or more liberal strategy but data is lacking on a wider range of resuscitation practices. We sought to examine the relationship between a wide range of fluid resuscitation practices and sepsis mortality and then identify the primary driver of this practice variation.DESIGN:Retrospective analysis of the Premier Healthcare Database.SETTING:Six hundred twelve U.S.

pmc-11496173.title: Isoliquiritigenin as a modulator of the Nrf2 signaling pathway: potential therapeutic implications
pmc-11496173.creator: Mangmang Qiu, Kang Ma, Junfeng Zhang, Zhaohua Zhao, Shan Wang, Qing Wang, Hao Xu
pmc-11496173.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Nuclear factor erythroid-2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), a transcription factor responsible for cytoprotection, plays a crucial role in regulating the expression of numerous antioxidant genes, thereby reducing reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels and safeguarding cells against oxidative stress. Extensive research has demonstrated the involvement of Nrf2 in various diseases, prompting the exploration of Nrf2 activation as a potential therapeutic approach for a variety of diseases.

pmc-11516376.title: Improving data quality by implementing an electronic medical record seems to depend on the context
pmc-11516376.creator: F Wurster, T Hansen, J Jaschke, J Köberlein-Neu, M R Okumu, H Pfaff, C Rusniok, U Karbach
pmc-11516376.description: BackgroundThe European healthcare system is reliant on its digital transformation to deal with challenges like rising expenditures or workforce shortage. The digital transformation is inevitably accompanied by the implementation of electronic medical records (EMR) and the ongoing adaptation of existing ones. Systematic reviews indicate that this process can have an impact on medical records data quality (DQ) [1].

pmc-11565330.title: Nomogram model for predicting long-term survival in esophageal cancer patients with metastasis after treatment: a SEER-based study
pmc-11565330.creator: Xiaomei Li, Daosheng Li, Shuming Qin, Hong Ye, Min Lin
pmc-11565330.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThere is a large variance in the long-term survival of esophageal cancer (EC) patients with metastasis after treatment. This study was designed to analyze long-term survival of metastatic EC patients after surgery, radiotherapy and chemotherapy.MethodsA retrospective cohort of EC patients with metastasis received surgery, radiotherapy and chemotherapy from 2004 to 2015 was obtained from the Surveillance, Epidemiology and End Results (SEER) database. Univariate Cox and complete subset regression analyses were performed to select prognostic factors.

pmc-11862075.title: Perceived vulnerability, fear of covid-19, and psychological distress of military hospital healthcare workers
pmc-11862075.creator: C Papathanasiou, D Christodoulias
pmc-11862075.description: IntroductionThe healthcare workers of military hospitals are actively involved in the fight against covid-19, as part of the national healthcare systems. Therefore, these health professionals may experience symptoms of psychological distress.ObjectivesThe study of sociodemographic characteristics and pandemic-related psychosocial factors that affect the psychological distress of healthcare professionals in a military hospital.Methods 134 health professionals participated (- 34.

pmc-12412440.title: Pulsed field ablation of the premature ventricular contractions originating from the medial free wall of the right ventricular outflow tract infundibulum: a case report
pmc-12412440.creator: Łukasz Zarębski, Piotr Futyma
pmc-12412440.description: BackgroundPremature ventricular contractions (PVCs) originating from the infundibular region of the right ventricular outflow tract (RVOT) may be challenging to ablate due to thin myocardial wall and proximity to the coronary arteries in this region. In such anatomically sensitive regions, the use of radiofrequency (RF) energy may carry a risk of collateral injury or prove ineffective.

pmc-12501106.title: Open repair of a giant hepatic artery aneurysm
pmc-12501106.creator: Arunan Mahendravarman, Christopher Seng Hong Lim, Jaswinder Singh Samra
pmc-12501106.description: Hepatic artery aneurysms (HAAs) are rare vascular lesions with significant risk of rupture and high mortality if untreated. We report a 59-year-old male who re-presented with severe chest and abdominal pain 10 years after failed embolization of a known HAA.

pmc-12521625.title: Neuromyelitis Optica Mimicking Multiple Sclerosis: A Case Report and a Comprehensive Review of the Literature
pmc-12521625.creator: Sunil Thatal, Susmin Karki, Asmita Parajuli, Sweta Bhandari, Bibek K C, Dibasa Adhikari, Navin Kumar Sah
pmc-12521625.description: Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) may mimic other neurological conditions, including multiple sclerosis (MS). We report a 25‐year‐old woman with hypothyroidism and depression who presented with progressive quadriparesis. Positive aquaporin‐4 antibodies confirmed NMOSD. This case emphasizes the importance of considering NMOSD in patients with atypical demyelinating presentations and highlights the role of early diagnosis and targeted immunotherapy in improving outcomes.

pmc-12565283.title: The Synergistic Role of Sargassum horneri Fucoidan and Lactobacillus plantarum: Microbiome and Gut Barrier Restoration in Zebrafish Colitis
pmc-12565283.creator: N M Liyanage, D P Nagahawatta, H H A C K Jayawardhana, Jun-Geon Je, Li Yiqiao, Fengqi Yang, Young-Sang Kim, Kyung Yuk Ko, You-Jin Jeon, Emiliano Manzo
pmc-12565283.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a chronic inflammatory bowel disease marked by disruption of the intestinal barrier and gut microbiota imbalance, leading to significant impairment in patient quality of life. This study investigated the therapeutic efficacy of a synbiotic formulation composed of purified fucoidan from bloom-forming Sargassum horneri and the probiotic Lactobacillus plantarum in a dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced zebrafish model of UC. Polysaccharides from S. horneri were extracted using Celluclast-assisted extraction and fractionated via DEAE anion-exchange chromatography, resulting in six fucoidan fractions.

pmc-12992937.title: Protocol for quantifying the oxidative cleavage of amyloid-β using oxygen-18 isotope labeling and LC-MS/MS
pmc-12992937.creator: Yiying Zhu
pmc-12992937.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryHere, we present a protocol for quantifying the oxidative cleavage of amyloid-β using oxygen-18 labeling coupled with high-resolution LC–MS/MS. We describe procedures for amyloid-β peptide preparation, copper(II)/ascorbate-mediated oxidative cleavage, oxygen-18 incorporation, LC–MS/MS acquisition, and isotopologue-based quantitative data analysis. By incorporating oxygen-18 into newly generated C-termini during metal-driven cleavage and applying defined isotope conditions, this protocol enables site-specific identification of true cleavage-derived fragments while discriminating them from background signals arising from natural isotopic overlap and pre-existing impurities.

pmc-13239695.title: IFN-γ PET imaging stratifies and predicts response to CD137 agonism in a syngeneic colorectal tumor model
pmc-13239695.creator: Alexander John Deck, Allen-Dexter Saliganan, Savannah Lane, Hyejeong Jang, Kang Chen, Seongho Kim, Nerissa T. Viola
pmc-13239695.description: BackgroundThe secretion of interferon-γ (IFN-γ) by activated immune cells is one of the hallmarks of response to cancer immunotherapy. Hence, detection of this cytokine via imaging can help determine an activated antitumor immune response. We have previously shown that positron emission tomography (PET) imaging of IFN-γ using [89Zr]Zr-Deferoximane (DFO)-anti-IFN-γ measured changes in its intratumoral expression after immune modulation.

pmc-13272324.title: Sport fans’ self-esteem and supporting the team that won over the favorite
pmc-13272324.creator: Endzhe Takemura, Hirotaka Matsuoka
pmc-13272324.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Research purposeMost often, when their favorite team loses, sports fans are disappointed by the outcome and hostile to the winning team. However, in the tournaments, they also sometimes voice their support for the team that eliminated their favorite. The present study investigates these phenomena and proposes that fans supporting the team that eliminated the favorite in the tournament is a coping strategy. It is used to help fans mitigate the identity threat when direct competition between the team becomes unavailable.

pmc-13279202.title: Real-world evidence of RET fusion prevalence and testing in patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-13279202.creator: BN Cajiao Garcia, VD de Jager, CCHJ Epskamp-Kuijpers, AJ van der Wekken, SM Willems, LC van Kempen, E Schuuring

pmc-13346391.title: Approximate CT-free patient specific attenuation correction method for cardiac-dedicated pinhole CZT system: a feasibility phantom study
pmc-13346391.creator: Michel Hesse, Florian Dupont, Véronique Roelants
pmc-13346391.description: BackgroundMulti-pinhole cardiac-dedicated CZT gamma cameras improve clinical workflow by reducing acquisition duration and/or injected activities. As most of these systems lack integrated CT scanner, attenuation artifacts may appear in the reconstructed image depending on patient morphology. External CT-based attenuation correction is possible but requires manual SPECT-CT registration and increases patient absorbed dose.

pmc-13362090.title: Supervised machine learning-based prediction of modern contraceptive use among sexually active women in Nepal
pmc-13362090.creator: Jibesh Acharya, Divya Shakya, Ziad El-Khatib, Wenjun Mao, Ziad El-Khatib, Wenjun Mao, Leo Anthony Celi, Wenjun Mao, Ziad El-Khatib, Wenjun Mao, Leo Anthony Celi, Wenjun Mao, Leo Anthony Celi, Wenjun Mao
pmc-13362090.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Modern contraceptives play a key role in reducing maternal and infant mortality, preventing unsafe abortions, and advancing women’s social and economic participation. Despite their importance, contraceptive use remains uneven across subpopulations in Nepal. This study aimed to identify key predictors of modern contraceptive use among sexually active women using supervised machine learning and data from the 2022 Nepal Demographic and Health Survey. A total weighted sample of 7,090 women residing with their partners was analyzed.

pmc-13424167.creator: Bin-Bin Liu, Fang-Zhe Ai, Chen-Yang Liao, Chao Xu, Hai-Rui Luo, Jing Xuan, Yi-Gang Song, Min Li

pmc-13474500.creator: Kwabena Opoku-Addai, Gwendolyn Patience Mensah, Kwadwo Ameyaw Korsah, Esther Selasi Avinu, Frank Bediako Agyei, Ellen Marfowaah Ahenkorah
pmc-13474500.description: BackgroundOptimal diabetes self-management by individuals living with the condition is associated with improved quality of life, proper glycaemic control, and reduced mortality rates. However, individuals living with diabetes mellitus can self-manage their condition effectively when they are well-motivated and supported.

pmc-13505491.title: Microfilarial morphometry and molecular characterization of Setaria spp. from naturally infected cattle in Thailand
pmc-13505491.creator: Chattraporn Rungchalermlak, Ruttayaporn Ngasaman, Domechai Kaewnoi, Meayanee Kanjanaphan, Niorn Ratanapob, Pairpailin Jhaiaun, Apiraya Rudeekiatthamrong, Darunwan Chuensaengarun, Tanapat Mutchimadilok, Giang Thi Nguyen, Wissanuwat Chimnoi, Jumnongjit Phasuk, Tawin Inpankaew, Burin Nimsuphan, Ketsari
pmc-13505491.description: Filarioid nematodes cause reduced livestock productivity and economic losses worldwide. In cattle, differentiation of microfilariae based on morphology is challenging due to overlapping morphological characteristics. This study aimed to identify microfilariae in cattle blood and determine the prevalence and risk factors of filarial worm infection in Thailand using two microscopic diagnostic methods and molecular techniques.
